landing.title: Job alerts that reach you in time

hero.pill: Built for Kenya’s workers and employers
hero.body: KaziForce sends urgent job alerts straight to your WhatsApp or SMS, and keeps everything else calm and tidy.

ticks.sms: Alerts by SMS, even without data

how.title: How KaziForce alerts work
how.checkBody: Fake jobs and messages asking you to send money are stopped before they reach you.
how.sortBody: Each alert is marked Act now, Check today or When you're free, so you know what to do first.
how.sendTitle: We send it where you look
how.sendBody: Urgent alerts go to WhatsApp or SMS. If you miss one, we try your next choice.

levels.title: Smart alerts, easy to tell apart
levels.body: Every alert shows a colour, a picture and a word, so you never have to guess.
levels.urgent: Jobs that close soon, or a job offer you received.
levels.medium: Messages and updates on your applications.
levels.low: Tips and news. We also send these in one daily email.
levels.spam: Fake jobs and requests for money are stopped. You never see them.

control.title: You are in control
control.channels: Choose what comes first: WhatsApp, SMS or email.
control.quiet: Quiet hours: we will not disturb you at night, except for urgent job offers.
control.notImportant: Tap "Not important to me" to see fewer alerts like it.
control.language: Use KaziForce in English or Kiswahili.

employers.title: For employers
employers.body: Post a job and the right workers hear about it in minutes. You can see when each worker received your message.

footer.project: A student project at Strathmore University, Nairobi.
footer.privacy: WhatsApp and SMS alerts never include your personal details.
footer.tagline: Job alerts that reach you on time: urgent work by SMS or WhatsApp, everything else calm and tidy.

demo.title: Your alerts
demo.description: Example: new alerts sort themselves into Act now, Check today and When you’re free, and a scam message asking for money is caught and removed.
demo.urgentBody: Industrial Area · KSh 1,200 a day · closes in 2 hours
demo.mediumBody: Can you start at 7 tomorrow morning?
demo.scamTitle: Pay KES 5,000 to secure your Dubai job!
demo.blocked: 3 spam messages blocked today. You’re welcome.

channels.title: Alerts reach you where you look

workers.title: For workers
workers.body: Hear about the right job first, without your phone buzzing all day.

everyone.title: Easy to use, whether you’re 18 or 80
everyone.text: Big, clear letters, with a Large text setting and easy-to-read letter styles.
everyone.language: Every screen in English and Kiswahili.
everyone.slow: Light on data: works on a mid-range phone and a slow connection.
everyone.calm: Dark mode and Reduce motion, for comfortable reading.

cta.title: Ready? It takes one minute to join.
cta.sub: That’s less time than waiting for a matatu to fill up.
